reason: The hypothesis directly restates the finding from P1 and P3 that thermal exposure of FeCoNiMnCu (a very similar alloy) on SS-304 at 800 °C forms a protective Cr2O3 and spinel oxide layer that enhances wear resistance, and applies it to FeNiCrCoCu thin films. The mechanism of oxide-layer lubrication and wear reduction is well-established in the literature (P12, P17, P23, etc.) and is not combined with any new element or transferred to a significantly different regime. The proposal is essentially what P1 and P3 already demonstrated, with only a minor change in alloy composition (Mn replaced by Cr, which is already present) and the specification of a thin-film form, which is not justified by any new reasoning.
